notes: Two runs of T043 are recorded. Run 2 repeated everything run 1 ran, the same way, in new scratch clones (git clone --no-hardlinks, checkout of the tip, git log -1 checked; no pytest or extractor in the main tree). The run lists were read again from each clone's own workflow file and are unchanged: 21 modules on Part A, 23 on part-b, and 2 in part-b's py39-floor job. The rest is documentation and records.

The six failing node ids are #365's, the same on both tips, at the same first-divergence byte offsets as T003, wave-02 and run 1, and with the same baseline and generated sizes as run 1 (web-app 224224, microservices 261105, ascii-web-api 197843, mermaid-agentic-app 260842, free-text-microservice 221304, maestro-reference 52).
